_doc: Sinkhole (1v1, 2v2, 3v3): one life each and the floor falls away from the edges. Every shrink_every ticks the outermost ring of cells cracks as a warning, and shrink_warn ticks later it drops into a chasm for good; a fall is a knockout (fall_ko). Last side standing wins, or the healthier side at time. max_rings leaves a strip of floor in the middle. Times are in ticks (60 per second) unless named _seconds.
